Here are **current Domino’s voucher / promo codes** I found for the U.S. as of **June 7, 2026**. Availability can vary by store/location, so try them at checkout:

| Code | Reported offer |
|---|---|
| **1126** | 20% off orders ([goodshop.com](https://www.goodshop.com/coupons/dominos.com?utm_source=openai)) |
| **9214** | 20% off menu-priced orders ([goodshop.com](https://www.goodshop.com/coupons/dominos.com?utm_source=openai)) |
| **5385** | Large / 2-topping or specialty pizza deal, varies by source ([goodshop.com](https://www.goodshop.com/coupons/dominos.com?utm_source=openai)) |
| **50OFF** | 50% off pizzas / purchase, where accepted ([groupon.com](https://www.groupon.com/coupons/dominos?utm_source=openai)) |
| **35OFF** | 35–40% off orders, where accepted ([groupon.com](https://www.groupon.com/coupons/dominos?utm_source=openai)) |
| **1138** | Reported $25 off order ([groupon.com](https://www.groupon.com/coupons/dominos?utm_source=openai)) |
| **MIXANDMATCH** | Mix & Match-style deal; pricing may vary by location ([dealsfinders.com](https://dealsfinders.com/coupons/dominos/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **P50** | Reported 50% off pizza via app promo code ([picodi.com](https://www.picodi.com/us/dominos?utm_source=openai)) |
| **DOMNEW3** | Reported 50% off first 3 app orders ([dealsfinders.com](https://dealsfinders.com/coupons/dominos/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **4156** | Reported 50% off order ([dealsfinders.com](https://dealsfinders.com/coupons/dominos/?utm_source=openai)) |

**Best reliable option:** go to Domino’s official **Coupons/Deals** page in the app or website and choose your local store. Current national/local offers shown there include deals like **Mix & Match from $6.99 each**, **carryout from $7.99**, and **Perfect Combo for $19.99**, though prices may be higher in some locations. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/pages/order/coupon?lang=en&utm_source=openai))

Tip: Domino’s codes are often **store-specific**, and some third-party coupon codes may fail. Try the official deals first, then test codes like **1126**, **50OFF**, or **35OFF** before paying.
